meta.subject: Science
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Science Standard Six Term III 2024 English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.extraction_policy: Source-exhaustive bilingual framing from lesson text, image-heavy plant-use overview, medicinal table, fibre/timber classifications, plant–animal interaction, fact boxes, ICT, evaluation and HOTS. Unsupported evaluation answers are not supplied from outside knowledge.
source_notes: Both uploaded Term III 2024 English and Tamil books were used.

The English evaluation asks which medicinal plant has anticancer properties, whereas the Tamil evaluation asks which plant addresses vitamin-C deficiency. Only the Tamil/Amla item is retained as a normal answerable item because the medicinal table explicitly supports Amla for vitamin-C deficiency; the English anticancer answer is not supplied by the chapter text.
Evaluation items asking for India’s national tree and Tamil Nadu’s state tree are not turned into answered MCQs because Unit 5 itself does not provide those answers.
The desert-water HOTS prompt is preserved as a prompt/source note rather than filled with an outside explanation, because this chapter does not state the causal answer.
The chapter’s statement that plant fuel does not emit harmful gases is retained as textbook wording and not broadened beyond the source.
